publication.title: CNTools: A computational toolbox for cellular neighborhood analysis from multiplexed images
publication.authors: Tao Y, Feng F, Luo X, Reihsmann CV, Hopkirk AL, Cartailler J-P, Brissova M, Parker SCJ, Saunders DC, Liu J
publication.license_note: PLOS publishes under CC BY 4.0; S1 Data is redistributable with attribution.

sources.description: S1 Data: underlying numerical values for Figs 2A-C, 3A-D, 4A-D, 5A-B
CRC CODEX dataset: annotated cells, 35 patients, coordinates, cell types, original CC neighbourhood assignments (neighborhood10)
sources.redistribution_note: 223 MB and licence terms not confirmed for redistribution; not committed. Fetch with scripts/download.sh.

reproduction_target.panel_structure: 4 blocks (CN Enrichment Score, CN Frequency per CN) x (CC*, CNE), each 9 neighbourhoods x 28 cell types
reproduction_target.cc_star_definition: Per the Fig 3 legend, CC* is 'the original CC results' - the neighbourhood assignments from the original publication (deposited as neighborhood10), NOT a fresh CNTools CC run. Methods: ten original CNs with one dirt-enriched CN removed, leaving nine.
reproduction_target.dirt_cn_identification: neighborhood10 CN 1 is 70.4% dirt; every other CN is <= 3.75%.
